versions.changelog: v1.0.1 - Documentation cleanup. Frontmatter version quoted for CLI compatibility, added CHANGELOG.md. No behavior changes.

Initial release of Home Maintenance OS – your all-in-one home asset and maintenance tracker.

- Track home appliances, systems, and equipment across multiple properties.
- Maintain detailed service histories, including dates, work done, contractors, and costs.
- Build a contractor directory from your service providers and job history.
- Set up and manage recurring maintenance schedules with automatic reminders.
- Summarize spending and service records by appliance, contractor, or property.
